evidence_label: User confirmed deposit model; package-specific matters pending

policy_reference.website_status: Implemented locally; production deployment not evidenced

deposit_model.institutional_users: Authorised accounts may deposit and publish directly in permitted collections
deposit_model.repository_administrator: Authorises accounts/collection permissions and handles technical operation/support
deposit_model.compiler_assignment: Each dataset names its actual responsible human compiler/depositor; appointment of the administrator does not assign every compilation to that role

collection_scope.limits: Describe published aggregates honestly and confirm the chosen collection accepts that output

normal_deposit_terms.limits: Use normal DSpace terms for the actual submitting account; no separate custom agreement approval gate

rights_and_access.metadata: CC0 descriptive metadata; dataset-file rights remain item-specific

identifier_workstream: Existing approved Handle.net workstream; no new DOI project
registry_target: Approximately 9–10 October 2026; editorial acceptance time unknown
limits: Local packages do not establish public holdings or resolved source rights. This preparation does not authorise the agent to publish datasets or change production permissions.
